cues.en: This is a short video, but it's an important point because many students in various courses of mine
cues.zh: 這支影片很短，但重點很重要，因為我不同課程的許多學生，

cues.en: ask me about my opinion and my policy on sharing the code that they have downloaded from this course.
cues.zh: 會問我對分享下載自課程的程式碼，有什麼看法或政策。

cues.en: And well, my policy is very simple.
If you would like to share the course code from this course, then yeah, go for it.
cues.zh: 如果想分享本課程的程式碼，沒問題，去做吧。

cues.en: You can post it on your GitHub page or on a blog or something like that, or share it with your friends and colleagues.
cues.zh: 可以放到自己的 GitHub、部落格等，或分享給朋友、同事。

cues.en: I ask you to if you are sharing my code files that I wrote, please include my name and the course website, or at least the course name on each code file that you share.
cues.zh: 但如果分享我寫的程式檔，請在每個檔案附上我的名字與課程網址，或至少課程名稱。

cues.en: And that's basically just a way of attributing the original file.
cues.zh: 基本上就是標明原始檔案的出處。

cues.en: And if you have modified the code, which by the way, I very strongly encourage, I want you to treat the code that I give you here in this course as template code that you can modify for future use.
cues.zh: 如果有修改程式，順帶說，我非常鼓勵；希望你把課程程式當成範本，修改後供未來使用。

cues.en: Then you can you can just add another line or comment that says modified from the original.
cues.zh: 可以再加一行或註解，寫明由原始版本修改。

cues.en: And if you are using if you want to use my code for commercial applications, basically that means if you are going to be making money off of the code that I wrote, then please contact me and discuss it
cues.zh: 如果想用在商業應用，基本上就是透過我寫的程式賺錢，請先聯絡我，和我，

cues.en: If you are using my code for educational purposes and research purposes, then you don't need to ask me.
cues.zh: 若用於教育和研究，就不必問我。

cues.en: Just please mention my name and actually in the code you will see when you download the course code that I already have some identifying information in there, so that's good enough for me.
cues.zh: 只要提到我的名字；下載的課程程式裡，其實已經有一些識別資訊，保留那些就夠了。
